name: @shady-pip/rivc-preview
description: Browser previewer and golden-image tests for Pip's compiled .riv

scripts.preview: . ../../scripts/env.sh && src="${PREVIEW_SRC:-packages/pip-rive/pip/pip.json}" && case "$src" in /*) ;; *) src="$SHADY_PIP_ROOT/$src" ;; esac && echo "preview: open http://localhost:${PORT:-8787}/" && bash serve.sh "$src"
scripts.dev: . ../../scripts/env.sh && src="${PREVIEW_SRC:-packages/pip-rive/pip/pip.json}" && case "$src" in /*) ;; *) src="$SHADY_PIP_ROOT/$src" ;; esac && echo "preview: open http://localhost:${PORT:-8787}/" && bash serve.sh "$src"
